text.tspan: Annual area burnt by wildfires by region 2002 to 2025
Total area of all land types burnt by wildfires in hectares.

tspan.tspan: For these historical estimates, we rely on data based on the NASA MCD64 MODIS sensor, which, according to the data provider, might

text.tspan: underestimate burnt areas and fire occurrences.
